seoTitle: Create Horizontal Scrolling Images in Squarespace
metaDescription: Build a horizontal image gallery in Squarespace with autoplay and thumbnails using the built-in Slideshow Simple layout.
intro: A horizontal scrolling image gallery is a great way to showcase a portfolio, product line, or photo collection in an interactive format. This guide covers setting up an image section, switching it to slideshow view, and enabling thumbnails and autoplay.

steps.heading: Log in and open the editor
steps.body: Sign in to Squarespace, select the website you want to edit, and enter the site editor.

steps.heading: Add an Images section
steps.body: Click Add Section, then choose the Images tab and select Gallery View to organize your images.

steps.heading: Switch to Slideshow Simple
steps.body: Click Edit Section, open the Grid dropdown, and choose Slideshow Simple to convert the layout into a scrolling slideshow.

steps.heading: Enable thumbnails and autoplay
steps.body: Turn on the thumbnails option so visitors can preview each image, then enable autoplay so the slideshow progresses without manual navigation.

steps.heading: Adjust the slide duration
steps.body: Scale the slide duration to a pace that keeps the gallery engaging without feeling rushed or too slow.

faq.question: Does Squarespace support autoplay for image galleries?
faq.answer: Yes, once you're in Slideshow Simple layout, you can toggle autoplay so the images advance automatically.

faq.question: What's the difference between grid and slideshow layouts?
faq.answer: Grid layout displays images in a static arrangement, while Slideshow Simple creates a scrolling, sequential presentation.

faq.question: Can I show thumbnails alongside the main slideshow?
faq.answer: Yes, turning on the thumbnails option adds a preview strip so visitors can jump to specific images.

faq.question: How do I control how fast the slideshow moves?
faq.answer: Adjust the slide duration setting in the gallery section to speed up or slow down the pacing.
